A quiet place to read

A good reading page gives every sentence enough room. The words should feel unhurried, with a clear measure, familiar type and a useful rhythm between paragraphs. The design is modest on purpose: changes to its width are easy to see, but the content must remain exactly the same.

The article can be read on a large screen or on a phone. Neither reader should need to scroll sideways to finish a sentence. When a theme adds a narrower container, the extra wrapping can look like a content problem even though every word is still present.

Keep the words. Correct the layout. Check the result at both sizes.

The highlighted note is part of the article, not a picture of some text. It should fit within the available width, stay in the reading order and remain editable through the normal paragraph control. A successful correction fixes the layout without rewriting the message.

After checking the page, inspect the shared closing note as a separate region. It has a different purpose and a wider measure. Matching these two regions by meaning makes the comparison useful even when the reference and WordPress use different element trees.
